assets.label: Fig7
assets.caption: Fig.7. ArchitectureoftheSpatio-TemporalDeformableFusion(STDF) Framework.TheSTDFframeworkenhancescompressedvideoqualityby aligningreferenceframesatthefeaturelevelusingSpatio-Temporal Deformable Convolution (STDC). Instead of relying on optical ﬂow, it predicts an offset ﬁeld through the Base Convolution and Offset Prediction modules to deformthespatio-temporalsamplingpositionsofconvolutions.Thealigned featuresarethenprocessedthroughtheQualityEnhancementmoduleto producetheenhancedoutputYtfromtheinputXt.Thisﬁgureisadapted fromtheoriginalSTDFpaper[85]withproperattribution.
